findings.what: No cost numbers anywhere on the overview. Banks show only a fee-schedule date, so nothing can be compared at a glance.

The heading 'בתי השקעות' covers a foreign broker (Interactive Brokers), a fund brand you can't open an account with (קסם: only 'קרנות סל · קרנות מחקות'), and companies that are mostly insurers (הראל, מגדל, הפניקס). That makes me doubt the grouping as a whole.
Index providers (MSCI, Nasdaq, S&P Dow Jones Indices) sit in the same list as fund managers, with BlackRock and its iShares brand as separate entries and a single REIT company (ריט 1) among them.
For someone who wants a trading account, most rows are irrelevant: only a handful have 'חשבון ניירות ערך', and there's no filter for that on this view.
Three entries have no fee-schedule date ('ללא תאריך פרסום'), including Mizrahi and Pessagot.
